def VTask.sumLexLift {α₁ : Type _} {α₂ : Type _} {β₁ : Type _} {β₂ : Type _} {γ₁ : Type _} {γ₂ : Type _}
  (f₁ : α₁ → β₁ → Finset γ₁) (f₂ : α₂ → β₂ → Finset γ₂)
  (g₁ : α₁ → β₂ → Finset γ₁) (g₂ : α₁ → β₂ → Finset γ₂)
  (a : α₁ ⊕ α₂) (b : β₁ ⊕ β₂) : Finset (γ₁ ⊕ γ₂) :=
  match a, b with
  | .inl a₁, .inl b₁ => Finset.map Sum.inl (f₁ a₁ b₁)
  | .inl a₁, .inr b₂ => Finset.disjSum (g₁ a₁ b₂) (g₂ a₁ b₂)
  | .inr a₂, .inl _ => Finset.empty
  | .inr a₂, .inr b₂ => Finset.map Sum.inr (f₂ a₂ b₂)
